The symbol floats alone on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn behind or under it. Subject: a zombie bite: a set of big blunt ivory-white teeth in two curved rows, upper and lower, closing on each other like a biting mouth seen from the front, with a dark slate-grey gap between the rows; no lips, no face, one simple shape. chibi-effect-raise.subject: EFFECT:RAISE
chibi-effect-raise.notes: The ground-removal edit of raise-b, palette-mapped: two bony pale ivory-grey skeleton hands reaching up with slate-blue wisps curling around the wrists, black outline, nothing under them (the tile and campfire are gone). Reads as hands rising at 40 and 30 px.

chibi-effect-splash.subject: EFFECT:SPLASH
chibi-effect-splash.notes: Frost starburst, palette-mapped: pale blue-white spikes with slate shading around a white core, black outline, no plate. The candidate's cyan core and red-orange tip specks map to pale blue and slate. Reads as a burst at 48 px and at 36 px (zoom 0.75).

chibi-effect-wail.subject: EFFECT:WAIL
chibi-effect-wail.notes: Two bold ((( ))) sound-wave fans in white and pale blue-grey with slate shading and a black outline, palette-mapped (no colour moved much). Symmetric, no plate; reads as a shriek at 48 and 36 px.

chibi-effect-wisp.subject: EFFECT:WISP
chibi-effect-wisp.notes: A curled pale blue-white spirit orb with a white core and slate shading, palette-mapped (the candidate's saturated sky blue becomes pale blue-grey). Reads as a small soul wisp at 24 and 18 px; used for Lifesteal and the Infect and Bitten risings. No plate.

chibi-marker-bitten.subject: STATUS:BITTEN
chibi-marker-bitten.notes: Chattering teeth, palette-mapped: an upper and a lower slate-grey jaw with ivory fangs, black outline. The candidate's red gums, green and orange bands become slate, so nothing reads as Coral, Teal or Gold. At 16 px in the marker frame it reads as two jaws, echoing the dock's bite glyph.

chibi-marker-plagued.subject: STATUS:PLAGUED
chibi-marker-plagued.notes: A puffy grey-green cloud with a queasy face and a black outline, palette-mapped (the candidate's stray red and purple outline pixels become the dark outline). Reads as a sick cloud at 16 px in the marker frame and at 32 px as the Plague puff; grey-green is far from Teal in hue and saturation. No plate.
